# U.S. News

> U.S. News provides comprehensive car pricing, shopping tools, and vehicle marketplace services for new and used cars with real-time dealer pricing and electric vehicle listings.

U.S. News operates a car shopping and pricing platform integrated with industry partners like TrueCar and Experian AutoCheck. The site specializes in vehicle valuation, price comparison tools, and marketplace listings for both traditional and electric vehicles across major markets.

- [U.S. News Best Price Program](https://bestprice.cars.usnews.com/?linkto=registration&u1=nojs): U.S. News Best Price Program registration for car pricing and shopping
